name: Premier Energies Ltd
title: Premier Energies Ltd - 544238 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Premier Energies' cell and module capacity heads to 16.75 GW by July 2026 with a ₹5,100 crore FY27 capex plan, while management declined to guide on margins despite rising cell and silver costs.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ₹5,100 crore
triggers.quote: FY27 is a year of large capex for us at INR5,100 crores to be deployed across cells, ingot wafers, batteries and inverters.

triggers.label: TOPCon cell line at 90%+
triggers.quote: is now running at 90% plus levels

triggers.label: Order book ₹14,010 crore, up 66%
triggers.quote: This is reflected in our growth order book, which currently stands at INR14,010 crores, up 66% year-on-year.

triggers.label: Non-DCR cell prices 3.5c to ~6c
triggers.quote: they have gone up from 3.5 cents level to almost 6, 6.2 cents

guidance.quote: total capacity set to increase nearly sevenfold to 16.75 GVA by July 2026
we want to maintain the debt-to-equity ratio at about 1 and debt-to-EBITDA ratio at about 1.5 or below
the 7 gigawatt plant, 4.8 June and 2.2 September is on track

red_flags.label: Margin guidance declined amid cost inflation
red_flags.quote: we can't give you any guidance on margin

red_flags.label: Inventory build and net debt rising
red_flags.quote: There's this sharp increase of inventory, I mean, your working capital getting blocked.

red_flags.label: Utility-scale demand deferred to FY28-29
red_flags.quote: the demand is going to come, I would say, towards the end of FY28 and 29 onwards

evasions.quote: we can't give you any guidance on margin. We as a company, we don't give any futuristic, we don't make any futuristic statements.
we've decided to basically pace our capacity addition program for this business
